# Focused foundational-consistency profile

Perform a narrow second-pass review of frozen decisions, normative documents,
trusted-boundary assignments, rule crosswalks, and versioning consequences.
Keep the base prompt's trust rules, severity definitions, foundational
firewall, and JSON output contract unchanged.

Cross-check every changed normative statement against the charter, Core v0.1
rules, format, manifest, audit model, failure classes, metatheory, decisions,
and conformance specifications supplied in the packet. Look for contradictory
rules, implicit theory, shifted ownership, unversioned serialized meaning, or
acceptance criteria that no longer characterize one frozen system. If the only
resolution changes a frozen decision, the verdict must be
`foundational_stop`; do not disguise that change as clarification.
